name: Pak Army Initial Test Practice
fullName: Pakistan Army soldier recruitment (initial) written and intelligence test
notes: 4 tests x 50 = 200, every item used once in tests (no spares). The Pakistan Army publishes no syllabus, question count, time or pass mark for the soldier written test; the Associated Press of Pakistan (2025 drive) lists a written test, physical and medical tests and an interview at the Army Selection and Recruitment Centres. Guides describe verbal and non-verbal intelligence sections plus matric-level MCQs (English, maths, GK, Islamiat, Pak Studies). 4 x 50 at 70% (35 of 50) is Tigertest's target; weights are Tigertest's own. Non-verbal items are written as text patterns. GK lane in this batch: the Army's ranks, corps and institutions, everyday science, Islamiat basics, Pakistan's national symbols (ppsc has Pakistan Studies and the Constitution; punjabpolice Punjab and law; pkpaf aviation and physics). No current affairs, office-holders, conflicts or Kashmir. Dashboard = 5 sets + 4 tests = 9 steps.
